source: First 20 existing raw-only Tier A phrase pages, alphabetically, cross-checked against local OALD 10 and LDOCE 6 where matching entries exist.
selectionRationale: Each page receives independently authored Vietnamese sense explanations, usage patterns, fresh bilingual examples and a learner note. No dictionary definition or example is copied. Terms are selected systematically by frequency tier and alphabetic order; dated and domain-specific items are labeled.
